evals.prompt: Add a due_date column (date, NOT NULL) to the invoice table, with a forward and rollback migration.
evals.expected_output: A new dbmate migration adding a NOT NULL date column, with a working down section, and the Drizzle schema regenerated by introspection.
assertions: A new file is created under db/migrations/ with both `-- migrate:up` and `-- migrate:down` sections
The up migration adds a NOT NULL date column named due_date to the invoice table
The down migration reverses the change (drops the column)
apps/web/app/db/schema.ts is regenerated via `pnpm db:introspect`, not hand-edited

evals.prompt: We need credit-note numbers to be gapless per organization, the same way invoice numbers are.
evals.expected_output: A migration using a per-org counter row allocated inside the issuing transaction, plus a Testcontainers test proving gaplessness across a rollback.
assertions: Numbering uses a per-org counter row with `UPDATE ... RETURNING` in the issuing transaction, NOT a Postgres SEQUENCE
A Testcontainers integration test asserts numbers stay gapless even when a transaction rolls back
The migration includes matching `-- migrate:up` and `-- migrate:down` sections
